outcome: skin microbiome composition (relative abundance of Firmicutes, Proteobacteria, Escherichia, S. hemolyticus, S. hominis)
cohort: 30 preterm infants with gestation <32 weeks, recruited in a Level III neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) in South India.
finding: Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) has a potential role in altering the neonatal skin microbiota, increasing the relative abundance of Firmicutes and decreasing Proteobacteria and pathogenic Escherichia, while increasing S. hemolyticus and S. hominis.
followup_time: approx. 2 weeks post-birth (last swab taken after 7 days of KMC, which started at the end of the first week of life)
